title: Refresh Window flushing cached joins
description: Performance rule — Refresh Window with 'Flush cached join results' (or 'Flush cached external data') discards relationship caches and forces FileMaker to re-fetch related records from the server. Claris explicitly warns about the network cost.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Flushing the join cache invalidates every cached related record: the next display of any related data goes back to the server. Inside a loop or on a busy layout this multiplies into a stream of avoidable round trips. Plain Refresh Window (without flush) is cheap by comparison and therefore not reported — its count appears as a context KPI only.
rule.remediation: Remove the flush option unless a stale join result is the actual problem being fixed; prefer Refresh Object or Refresh Portal for targeted updates. If a flush is genuinely needed, keep it out of loops.

meta.description: Detects enabled Refresh Window steps whose flush options are set. The options are read via their numeric ids (256 = join results, 512 = external data) — the type attribute of the Boolean parameter follows the export language and must not be matched. Loop context is reported per finding.
